name: omniframe-studio
description: Open-source, agent-first video & animation control platform that unifies code-driven frame-by-frame rendering, 2D cartoon pipeline, and professional NLE/compositing bridges under one architecture.

code_video.description: Code-driven frame rendering via HTML/CSS/JS with Playwright deterministic capture

cartoon_2d.description: 2D cartoon animation rendering with layers, keyframes, and Pillow compositing

compositor.description: FFmpeg-based video assembly with audio mixing, subtitles, LUTs, and export presets

bridges.description: DCC (Digital Content Creation) bridge adapters for host application integration

determinism.strategy: Frame-level seeded PRNG (mulberry32), CSS animation freeze, double-rAF settle, __OMNIFRAME_READY__ opt-in

error_model.hierarchy: OmniFrameError with stable code field for agent branching

checkpoint_storage.strategy: Filesystem JSON snapshots under .omniframe/checkpoints/ with SHA-256 content hash

test_markers.render: Tests requiring Playwright browser frame capture
